title: Relative ampleness can be checked on an affine open cover of the base
statement: Let $h:Z\to S$ be a quasi-compact morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-finite-type-morphism] and let $N$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_Z$-module [def-sc-invertible-module]. Suppose $S=\bigcup_{i\in I}U_i$ is an affine open covering and $N|_{h^{-1}(U_i)}$ is ample [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module] for every $i\in I$. Then $N|_{h^{-1}(V)}$ is ample for every affine open $V\subseteq S$.

source.place: Tag 01VJ (lemma-characterize-relatively-ample), implication (3) implies (1). The conclusion unfolds f-ampleness into ampleness over every affine open of the base.
